name: In Another World with My Smartphone: Fantasia Connect
summary: In Another World with My Smartphone: Fantasia Connect is a free-to-play idle role-playing browser game published by CTW, Inc. on the G123 platform. Based on the second season of the In Another World with My Smartphone anime — itself adapted from the light novel series by Patora Fuyuhara published by Hobby Japan — the title casts players as Touya Mochizuki, undertaking guild requests with heroines such as Yumina and Linze across kingdoms including Belfast. Battles resolve automatically, and progression draws on an idle resource system with party composition built from companions and summoned beasts.
